summary: Plan adoption, measure transformation progress and build practical change artefacts. Explore this five-day transformational change training course.
lede: Transformational change training helps leaders, change practitioners and programme teams turn strategic shifts into coordinated work and measurable adoption. Participants practise assessing role impacts and readiness, planning adoption with change frameworks, and tracking benefits and outcomes. They also develop practical tools such as a transformation roadmap, stakeholder map and progress scorecard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate or lead a strategic transformation and need practical ways to connect intended outcomes with team-level adoption and measurable progress.
modules: Theory of Change and Transformation Outcomes
prerequisites: No specialist change-framework knowledge is assumed. Familiarity with your team’s or function’s current priorities will help you apply the exercises to a realistic context. Coding or programming is not required.
